chunks: To the chosen servants of God
ai.seo_question: Who are the Mukhlasun (chosen servants) in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this phrase highlights the unique spiritual station of the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the ultimate 'Mukhlasun' due to their infallibility (Ismah) and exclusive closeness to God. It serves as a key verse for understanding the hierarchy of divine servitude, distinguishing the purified Imams from the general righteous believers.
